name: fuck-cancer
title_zh: 全家人的癌症病历，你问它答、它问你记
tagline_zh: 确诊后信息像雪片飞来，病理、分期、方案散在微信和PDF里。它把碎片拢成一份活病历，下次见医生前自动生成一页纸摘要。
tagline_en: Scattered pathology, staging, and treatment notes become one structured file. Before each appointment, it hands.
desc_en: Create and maintain one family medical brief from reports, notes, or partial information. Use when the user asks any cancer-related question or shares any cancer-related update, including symptoms during a workup, diagnosis, pathology, biomarkers, staging, treatment, recurrence, appointments, trials, second opinions, or caregiving decisions.
why_zh: 不是聊天机器人，是持续维护的结构化档案。每次对话都校验旧信息、追问缺口，让家属从翻聊天记录里解放出来。
why_en: It's a curator, not a chatbot. Every update cross-checks old entries and asks what's missing, so you stop digging through chat.
limit_zh: 只维护文字医疗信息，不读影像原片、不解读基因报告原始数据；产出的摘要需主治医生复核，不能替代临床决策。
limit_en: Text-only; no imaging or raw genomics. Summaries need oncologist review—never a substitute for clinical decisions.
title_en: One living cancer brief for the whole family, kept by Q&A
